captures.description: THE AI HALLUCINATION CASES DATABASE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'the primary public database tracking generative AI hallucinations in court decisions... created and maintained by Damien Charlotin'; it tracks decisions where AI 'explicitly produced hallucinated content'; 'over 2,200 documented decisions globally' as of October 2026, US courts the majority; the parties (lawyers, pro se litigants, experts, prosecutors, judges) and the sanctions; and a UK companion, the AI Hallucination Cases Tracker. Six cards: Charlotin's site, Natural and Artificial Law (the UK tracker), HAQQ's '2202-Case Sanctions Tracker', a LinkedIn post at 1,600 cases, two videos.

atoms.evidence: is the AI Hallucination Cases Database
created and maintained by Damien Charlotin
As of October 2026, the database contains over 2,200 documented decisions globally
It tracks court and tribunal decisions where generative AI explicitly produced hallucinated content, most commonly fake legal citations, fabricated quotes, and non-existent case law.
